entries.speaker: Enemy Strength
entries.en: You can view [clr 2]the strength of an enemy[clr 27] by using[n]Third Eye. The color that appears will indicate[n]their level relative to yours.

entries.speaker: Enemy Strength
entries.en: Red enemies are of a higher level, yellow ones[n]are about the same level, and blue ones are[n]of a lower level.
